events.summary: General Jarkeld meets his end rallying troops; 'last words' urge standing their ground.
events.quote: "Stand your ground, troops! This shall be our finest hour!"

events.summary: Halvor Arenson asks that Jarkeld and his troops, who perished in the Adarkar Wastes, be remembered.
events.quote: "Let us remember brave Jarkeld and his troops, who perished in the Adarkar Wastes so long ago."

events.summary: Sorine Relicbane urges remembering the horrors of the Brothers' War.
events.quote: "I implore you not to forget the horrors of the past. You would have us start the Brothers' War anew!"

events.summary: Taaveti praises the Kjeldorans as allies.
events.quote: "I have been a warrior for over four hundred years, and yet each generation of Kjeldorans teaches me new tricks. There can be no better allies."

events.summary: Lucilde Fiksdotter argues for the Order admitting those of peasant birth.
events.quote: "Shall we turn away a worthy soul because his parents were peasants? I think not."

events.summary: Avram Garrisson relishes soldiers kicking down doors of the impure.
events.quote: "There's nothing I like better than watching a street full of soldiers kicking down the doors of the guilty and the impure."

events.summary: Avram Garrisson complains the queen sent mercenaries.
events.quote: "Blasted amateurs! Doesn't the queen think we can fight well enough on our own?"

events.summary: Arna Kennerüd tells a shield bearer he will soon be a Skyknight.
events.quote: "You have almost completed your four years, my son. Soon you shall be a Skyknight."

events.summary: Arna Kennerüd speaks of fighting and dying as one with his Aesthir.
events.quote: "My Aesthir is my most trusted ally. We fight as one and live as one, and we will die as one."

events.summary: Zur the Enchanter declares he and his followers are Kjeldorans no more.
events.quote: "We are Kjeldorans no more."

events.summary: Gustha Ebbasdotter defeats Zur, who boasted he would eat her soul.
events.quote: He boasted that he would eat my soul—but all he ate were his words."

events.summary: Disa the Restless's expedition travels far west and finds ice walls blocking travel.
events.quote: "We are farther west than any could have imagined possible, but I still wish to press on.

events.summary: Disa the Restless records the pass blocked by an avalanche, forcing the expedition back.
events.quote: "The pass was completely blocked by the avalanche; we're forced to turn back.

events.summary: Disa records the Dryads' lies led to deaths in the cold.
events.quote: The rest believed their lies, and their skeletons weren't found until the thaw."

events.summary: Disa records the Shaman waving a staff and the land going mad.
events.quote: "The Shaman waved the staff, and the land itself went mad."

events.summary: Gerda Äagesdotter describes the secret school of illusion.
events.quote: "This school was founded in secret, operates in secret, and exists for the teaching of secrets.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl calls for the gates to be opened for the dead.
events.quote: "Open the gates, and bid them enter."

events.summary: Lim-Dûl swears his service to Leshrac and asks for power.
events.quote: "Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."

events.summary: Lim-Dûl orders the dead of his enemies entombed in snow to rise as servants.
events.quote: "Take their dead, and entomb them in the snow. Risen, they shall serve a new purpose."

events.summary: Lim-Dûl swears himself to Leshrac, body and soul.
events.quote: Blood for blood, flesh for flesh, Leshrac, my lord."

events.summary: Lim-Dûl boasts his Moor Fiends will rend Krov's people.
events.quote: My fiends shall yet rend their flesh from their bones."

events.summary: Lucilde sees the faces of her dead friends among Lim-Dûl's legions.
events.quote: "I have seen the faces of my dead friends among that grim band, and I can bear no more."

events.summary: Lucilde's party chases Lim-Dûl when a ridge crumbles.
events.quote: "We were chasing Lim-Dûl when the ridge in front of us suddenly crumbled.

events.summary: Halvor Arenson says Marit Lage's presence is still felt.
events.quote: "Our world has not felt her thundering steps in lifetimes, but Marit Lage's presence is still with us."

events.summary: Kolbjörn says Freyalise cleansed the druids' bodies and gave them Fyndhorn.
events.quote: "Freyalise has cleansed our bodies and minds of the plagues of Kjeldor;

events.summary: Kolbjörn laments no child has been born with the Mark to succeed him.
events.quote: still no child has been born with the Mark to take my place.

events.summary: Laina speaks of joining the Juniper Order druids in faith.
events.quote: "We have joined with the Druids of the Juniper Order. Our faith is one."

events.summary: Saffi Eriksdotter shouts a warning about the Lhurgoyf as her last words.
events.quote: "Ach! Hans, run! It's the Lhurgoyf!"

events.summary: Lovisa Coldeyes tells her daughter she'll receive her true name after killing a Pale Bear.
events.quote: "Daughter, on the day you have killed your Pale Bear, then will I give you your true name."

events.summary: Arcum Dagsson hopes artificers' power will be used wisely.
events.quote: "Perhaps this time the power of the artificers shall be used wisely."

events.summary: Sorine Relicbane urges destroying that which destroyed them long ago.
events.quote: Destroy that which destroyed us, so long ago."

events.summary: Arcum Dagsson wishes the forces that took Argoth never return.
events.quote: "May the forces that took Argoth beneath the waves never come among us again."

events.summary: Arna Kennerüd vows to oppose Lim-Dûl by any means.
events.quote: "We shall oppose Lim-Dûl and his forces by any means necessary, even if the very earth be torn asunder."

events.summary: Dagsson argues artifacts helped them survive Lim-Dûl's horrors.
events.quote: Would Relicbane prefer we had been slain by Lim-Dûl's horrors?"

relations.quote: "Do we know what we're doing? Yes—the will of Freyalise."
